name: ASX Limited
summary: ASX Limited operates as a multi-asset class and integrated exchange company in Australia and internationally. It operates markets for securities and derivatives which offers full service across listings, trading, clearing, settlement, registry, and information and technical services through regulated and non-regulated legal entities. The company provides regulated framework for entities to raise capital and source liquidity; education programs, research and insights, investor access, and peer group networking; and distribution facility for quoted exchange traded funds (ETFs) and debt securities.
